title: Submerged Ledger
description: A bass-led, hypnotic 707 roller that breathes underwater: a deep sine sub leads a rolling minor progression while bitcrushed hats stutter off the grid. It climbs to a first peak, sinks into a sub-only valley, then surfaces for a harder second peak before settling back down.
code:
setcpm(124/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(160,420).slow(12)).gain(0.62).shape(0.18).room(0.25),
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.92).lpf(900),
    s("hh(3,8)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.4).crush(7).cut(1).pan(perlin.range(0.35,0.65))
  )],
  [24, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(180,520).slow(14)).gain(0.64).shape(0.2).fm(2).fmh(1).room(0.25),
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.96),
    s("hh(5,8,2)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.42).crush(6).cut(1).swingBy(0.08,8).pan(perlin.range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.5).room(0.3)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(220,640).slow(16)).gain(0.66).shape(0.22).fm(3).fmh(2).room(0.28),

    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.44).crush(6).cut(1).swingBy(0.08,8).off(0.125, x => x.gain(0.3)),
    s("~ sd ~ sd").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.55).room(0.3),
    n("0 3 5 7").scale("C4:dorian").s("sine").lpf(1400).gain(0.4).shape(0.15).room(0.35).every(4, x => x.rev())
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 eb1 f1 g0>*2").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(140,360).slow(10)).gain(0.6).shape(0.18).room(0.4),
    n("<0 3 5 2>").scale("C4:phrygian").s("sine").lpf(900).gain(0.42).room(0.45).sometimesBy(0.3, x => x.add(note(12)))

  [28, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(260,760).slow(18)).gain(0.68).shape(0.26).fm(4).fmh(2).room(0.28),
    s("bd*4").bank("RolandTR707").gain(1.05),
    s("hh(7,8,2)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.46).crush(5).cut(1).swingBy(0.08,8).ply("<1 1 2 4>"),
    s("~ cp ~ cp").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.55).room(0.3).every(8, x => x.ply(2)),
    s("lt(3,8,4)").bank("RolandTR707").gain(0.5).shape(0.2).pan(perlin.range(0.2,0.8)),
    n("0 3 5 7").scale("C4:dorian").s("sine").lpf(1700).gain(0.42).shape(0.18).room(0.35).off(0.25, x => x.add(note(7)).gain(0.3))
  )],
  [16, stack(
    note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>*4").s("sine").lpf(perlin.range(160,380).slow(12)).gain(0.62).shape(0.18).room(0.35),
